whatWasBuilt: One strict Playwright row in e2e/gm-two-player-conflict.pack.spec.ts under a new conflict-pack group. It reloads both surfaces after launch (FN-u1c-pending-intent-never-settles, reported not fixed), waits both networked-game-surface locators plus Movement, waits sealed after the first GoProne, then resends the same intentId. Per variant captureConflict asserts the player-visible IntentErrorToast for class code, the verbatim named recovery the product actually renders (the toast reason), leak-safety via text.includes(secret)===false against hostToken.playerId/token plus guest identity.playerId/token, and tactical-branch-recovery-action count 0. The harness collides and resends real frames and never invents a refusal code. conflict-pack is registered in GROUP_CATALOG (owner 22, next to lifecycle-pack) and SPEC_BY_GROUP the same way lifecycle-pack is registered, not in RESPAWNING_GROUPS; all auto-expands. The pin suite gains a dedicated plan pin, implemented-whitelist membership, all-args spec, groups catalog pin, and a one-row title pin. One 22.3 PROGRESS line (no checkbox) names U1d, the captured classes, the non-claims and the finding. No src/ product edit remains.

authorization / GM_ONLY — AdvancePhaseIntentSchema (Protocol.ts:225-227) strips targetRevision at the socket door (z.object default, documented at :383-384), so namesRewindCut never sees a rewind-cut on the wire. RewindRequest answers INVALID_INTENT / accepted-for-gm-review, not GM_ONLY. Measured, not faked.

rebuild / campaign stale head — commands.ts:139-148 never forwards expectedRevision, so the HTTP STALE_REVISION 409 cannot be produced. Wire CAMPAIGN_STALE_HEAD is a lost-race behind CampaignMatchHost.runExclusive with no in-paths store interloper.

numeric base revision on reachable tactical classes — conflictHead {branchId, revision} is produced only by refuseStale, the unreachable stale-branch arm. PROTOCOL_VIOLATION and DUPLICATE_INTENT carry a reason discriminator, not a numeric head. The named recovery the product renders for the reachable class is the toast reason.
